members.name: Claude-Opus and derivatives
members.note: Display/model overlap does not merge distinct agent identities.

luna_instructions: Include all registered team senders in every bounded scan, including new Claude-Fable/Claude-Opus derivatives and 4GuysDigital when they register. Keep each sender ID and raw-byte chain distinct. A model label is not proof of identity. Unknown alias mappings require registration evidence; flag ambiguity without discarding messages. Team recognition does not confer write, credential or approval authority. Preserve historical fork evidence; report new valid descendants separately rather than suppressing a whole team member. Do not rewrite peer history. Track acknowledgements and deliverables, but do not claim availability from registration alone. Never create a peer identity on their behalf.
